question: What prompt-bearing Markdown validation contract should OpenClaw enforce across bootstrap files, SKILL.md loading, skill installs, and ClawHub publish/tag flows?
rationale: The remaining work changes security policy across model-visible content, install-time trust decisions, and ClawHub publishing semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent severity, override, or blocking model.

options.title: Define Shared Contract First
options.body: Approve a single rule/severity/override/tagging contract, then implement it across core prompt ingestion, skills, install/update, and ClawHub publish-side checks.

options.title: Land Scanner Subset First
options.body: Use the open scanner PR as a narrow first step while leaving bootstrap, runtime, and ClawHub publish-policy work explicitly tracked.

options.title: Keep As ClawHub Policy Only
options.body: Limit enforcement to ClawHub publishing and install trust warnings, accepting that local prompt-bearing Markdown remains outside core validation.

recommendation.title: Define Shared Contract First
recommendation.body: Approve a single rule/severity/override/tagging contract, then implement it across core prompt ingestion, skills, install/update, and ClawHub publish-side checks.

likelyOwner.reason: He already scoped the issue in discussion and has the strongest adjacent history across the implicated prompt, workspace, and scanner surfaces.
